comparison_identity.aggregation: equal complete-pair mean within each tokenizer, then maximum tokenizer mean (least-favourable) across the three; retain each marker separately
comparison_identity.comparator: registered surface versus concise meaning-complete careful English
comparison_identity.population: 64 prospective authored duration pairs, equal marker weights; fixed reference variants are not independent semantic frames
comparison_identity.unit_span: one complete claim sentence with exactly shared resolved references and units

aggregation.rule: equal complete-pair mean within each tokenizer, then maximum tokenizer mean (least-favourable) across the three; retain each marker separately

estimand_contract.contrast: registered surface versus concise meaning-complete careful English
estimand_contract.population: 64 prospective authored duration pairs, equal marker weights; fixed reference variants are not independent semantic frames
estimand_contract.unit_span: one complete claim sentence with exactly shared resolved references and units

manifest.selection: Thirty-two independently authored state/window scenarios across eight domains and four boundary classes, each contributing both required statistics. The ledger derives union, abutment, clipping, total, and longest-stretch gold before tokenizer exposure.
manifest.method: Copy the source comparison identity, estimand, tokenizer roster, member-span interval recipe, and ordered equal-weight strata exactly. Count proposed minus concise meaning-complete English tokens per complete pair and tokenizer; take the equal-pair mean per tokenizer and maximum tokenizer mean; report both statistic strata under that headline tokenizer. File every finite result once.
manifest.scope: Current tokenizer cost on this frozen prospective authored population only. This does not test reader comprehension, interval truth, adoption, or future-trained tokenizers.
